title: How to check PCB board quality?
desc: The simplest form of PCB inspection is manual visual inspection (MVI). In this process, a worker examines the circuit board either with the naked eye or using magnification tools. They compare the board against the design documents to ensure that all specifications have been met. Additionally, they check for common defects.

title: What are the four types of electrical PCB faults?
desc: Faults are classified into three types based on persistence: transient, semi-persistent, and persistent faults. Additionally, they can be categorized by symmetry into asymmetric and symmetric faults.

title: What are common electronics pcb board malfunctions?
desc: The most commonly encountered electronic failure modes include packaging, contacts, and printed circuit boards (PCBs). These components experience significant stress during operation, which increases their likelihood of malfunction and damage.

title: How thick is a 2 layer PCB?
desc: A 2-layer PCB can be as thin as 0.8 mm, while a 6-layer or 8-layer PCB may be 1.6 mm or thicker due to the added layers. When designing your PCB layer stackup, it's important to consider the dielectric thickness between the layers. This factor significantly affects signal integrity and impedance.
